title: བར་དོ་ཐོས་གྲོལ་ཆེན་མོ།
titleEn: The Tibetan Book of the Dead — The second bardo, and the third begins: the voices, lights and rays, and the first day
part: 3 · The second bardo, and the third begins: the voices, lights and rays, and the first day
draftNote: Read from one blockprint at the resolution of an online scan; doubtful places are marked in the notes, and the text has not yet been collated with other prints.
source: Zab chos zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol las: Chos nyid bar do'i gsal 'debs thos grol chen mo, pages 27–35 of the reproduction, from an undated Tibetan blockprint of the Thos grol cycle reproduced by the Buddhist Digital Resource Center as W23710 (text kha), read from the page images. It is a traditional blockprint, so no modern editor's work is involved. Two transcriptions found online, one of this print and one of another, were used to check the reading and are not the text. The page gives the print's wording and spelling. Three things are ours: the spaces between words, which Tibetan does not write; the line-end abbreviations, written out; and clear misprints corrected, each named in its note. Where another print reads differently in a way that matters, the note says so. Letters: the Wylie system (Extended Wylie for the Sanskrit words). Pronunciation: the reading style of central Tibet in the THL Simplified Phonetic Transcription (Germano and Tournadre, 2003), produced by rule from the spelling; a living reader's pronunciation will differ in places. The translation is new, made from the Tibetan. Still to do: the text has been read from one print at the resolution of an online scan, and doubtful places are marked in the notes; it has not been collated with the other blockprints.

sentences.l: The between first took-hold if, best. That not took-hold if, the between second in clear-reminding-by, the family(?) having-woken, then, freed it-is.
sentences.i: If it takes hold in the first bardo, that is best. If it does not, he is reminded in the second bardo, and by that what is in him by nature wakes, and he is freed.
sentences.n: The first words, bar do, stand at the end of p. 26, after the last sentence of the part before. bar do dang po thebs na rab: 'if it takes hold in the first bardo, best'; rab, 'best', as in the pilot's 'pho ba thebs na rab. The syllables pa la are uncertain: the print cuts them as one, པལ, either a contraction or pa la with its tsheg lost; the sense is pa la, 'in the second', either way, and it is written out. gdab bas is the print's spelling of gdab pas, 'by giving'. rigs, 'family, kind', is odd here: the other recension has rig pa sad nas, 'awareness wakes'. The print's rigs may stand for the same, or for the buddha-nature as one's 'family'; the translation is a guess. The plain stroke ། closes the sentence.

sentences.l: That too: the between second, impure's illusory-body so-called: died-or not died, face not knowing's clear flash, one, comes.
sentences.i: This second bardo is called the impure illusory body. There comes a flash of clarity in which the dead person does not know whether he has died or not.
sentences.n: sgyu lus, 'illusory body', is the body one seems to have after death, made of mind, not flesh; ma dag pa'i, 'impure', sets it apart from the pure illusory body of an accomplished yogin. shi'am ma shi, 'died, or not died', is the question of 002 put shortly: -'am is 'or'. gsal lam pa, 'a clear flash', makes a noun of the lam of 002's lam gyis, 'in a flash'; the other recension has shes pa gsal lam me ba, 'consciousness clear and flickering'. 'ong, 'comes', stands without a sentence ending, as it often does in this print.

sentences.l: Time at-that, the instruction took-hold if: reality-itself mother-child having-met, then, karma's turning-aside there-is-not.
sentences.i: If the instruction takes hold at that time, mother and child, the two clear lights of reality, meet, and karma can no longer turn him aside.
sentences.n: ma bu, 'mother and child', is a term of this teaching: the 'mother' is the clear light of reality itself, which dawns at death, and the 'child' is the clear light the practitioner came to know in meditation. Their meeting is recognition. kha bsgyur, 'to turn the face', is to divert, to turn aside; -du med, 'there is no ...-ing', says it cannot happen. las kyi, 'of karma', has the genitive where the other recension has las kyis, 'by karma', with the same sense.

sentences.i: If he is not freed there either, then the bardo of reality dawns, which is also called the third bardo.
sentences.n: The print has མགྲོལ, a misprint for མ་གྲོལ, corrected here: the tsheg after ma is missing, and only ma grol, 'not freed', gives sense, as in the other recension (des kyang ma grol na). zer, 'it is called', is the spoken verb of 002. 'char de is the print's spelling of 'char te, 'dawns, and'. The chos nyid bar do, the bardo of reality, is where the peaceful and wrathful deities appear; the rest of the book is about it.

sentences.i: At that time his relatives are weeping and lamenting, his share of food has been stopped, his clothes taken off,
sentences.n: de tsa na, 'at that time'. nye dus is nye du, 'relatives', with -s, 'by', marking who does it. The print reads du skad, which gives no sense; it is kept as printed. sentences.n: sgra 'od zer gsum, 'the three, sound, light and rays', come back again and again in what follows: 'od is light, zer the rays that stream from it. 'jigs skrag dngangs gsum, 'fear, terror and dread', are three near-synonyms; dngangs is the print's spelling of sngangs, 'to be terrified'. sentences.i: the natural bardo of the place of birth, the bardo of dream, the bardo of meditative concentration, the bardo of the moment of death, the bardo of reality, and the bardo of becoming that arises in sequence: these are the six.
sentences.n: The six bardos. rang bzhin skyes gnas, 'the natural place of birth', is this life itself, from birth to death; skyes gnas is the print's spelling of skye gnas, which the other recension has. ting nge 'dzin (samādhi) and bsam gtan (dhyāna) are two words for meditative absorption. srid pa, 'becoming', names the bardo in which one seeks a new birth. lugs 'byung, 'arising in order', is a guess at the sense; both recensions have it. de drug go, 'those are the six'.

sentences.i: Even if you are attached and cling, you have no power to stay; nothing will come of it but wandering in saṃsāra. Do not be attached, do not cling. Keep the Three Jewels in mind.
sentences.n: sdod dbang, 'the power to stay'. byas kyang, 'even if (you) do', makes the clause concessive, where the other recension has byas cing, 'doing, and'. sentences.i:
Alas! Now, when the bardo of reality dawns for me,
I shall give up all dread and terror, all fear of what appears,
and recognise whatever appears as awareness, arisen of itself;
I shall know it for the way the bardo appears.
sentences.n: Verse: six lines of nine syllables (the first with kye ma before it), which the dead person is to say to himself. The print writes dngangs with a small s under the second nga (དངངྶ); it is written out. The vowel of ngo in the third line cannot be seen apart from the letters of the line above; ngo shes, the set phrase, is the reading taken, and it is uncertain. 'jigs snang, 'fearful appearance'. spangs byas, 'made an abandoning', is 'having given up'. rang shar, 'arisen of itself'. rig par, 'as rig pa', awareness: what everything is to be recognised as. bya at the end of a line is 'I shall do': ngo shes bya, 'I shall recognise'. snang tshul, 'way of appearing'. Where this print has gang snang rang shar, 'whatever appears, self-arisen', the other recension has gang shar rang snang, 'whatever arises, self-appearing'.

sentences.n: ru log is uncertain: ru is a camp or a division of troops, and ru log, 'the camp turns back', seems to say that the course of saṃsāra is reversed; the sense given is a guess. sku ru, 'as bodies': ru is the 'as' ending after a vowel, like -r; sku, 'body', is the respectful word, used for the forms of buddhas and deities. The print writes nam at the head of p. 34 as ན with a small circle for m (ནཾ); it is written out. mthing kha, 'deep blue', is the print's spelling of mthing ga; with -r, 'as blue'. The other recension has 'od dang kha dog mthing gar, 'as blue light and colour'.

sentences.l: That's time-at, the centre-direction, Spread-Drop's realm from: the Blessed-One Vairocana, body-colour white, lion's throne on seated,
sentences.i: At that time, from the central realm called the Spreading Drop, the Blessed One Vairocana, white in colour, seated on a lion throne,
sentences.n: Here the first day begins: on each day one of the five buddhas appears. Rnam par snang mdzad, 'He Who Makes Appear in Every Way', is Vairocana, the buddha of the centre. bcom ldan, 'Blessed One', is a short form of bcom ldan 'das, the title of a buddha, which comes in full at the end of this part. Thig le brdal ba, 'the spread-out drop', is the name of his pure realm (zhing khams, 'field-realm'); thig le is 'drop, sphere' and brdal 'spread out', and the name is rendered word by word. sku mdog, 'body colour', the respectful word. The other recension adds mthing ka, 'blue', to the realm.

sentences.l: Hand in, wheel spokes eight holding, the mother Sky's-Expanse-Lady with face-joined, then, oneself to dawning comes.
sentences.i: holding an eight-spoked wheel in his hand, in union with his consort, the Lady of the Expanse of Space, will dawn before you.
sentences.n: phyag, 'hand', and bsnams, 'held', are respectful words. yum, 'mother', is a buddha's female partner; zhal sbyar, 'faces joined', is their union. Nam mkha'i dbyings phyug ma, 'Lady of the Expanse of Space' (dbyings, 'expanse'; phyug ma, 'rich one, mistress'), is the consort of Vairocana. The print writes nam mkha'i contracted (ནམཁའི) and, at the line end, dbyings with a small s under the nga (དབྱིངྶ); both are written out. rang la, 'to oneself', is 'to you'.

sentences.l: Consciousness's aggregate, in-its-place pure: light blue, the dharma-expanse's wisdom, colour blue, bright and clear,
sentences.i: The aggregate of consciousness, pure in its own place, is the blue light, the wisdom of the expanse of reality: blue in colour, bright and clear,
sentences.n: rnam par shes pa'i phung po, 'the heap of consciousness', is the fifth of the five aggregates (phung po, Sanskrit skandha) that make up a person; on each day one aggregate shows in its pure form as a buddha's light. gnas su dag pa, 'pure in its place'; the other recension has dag pas, 'because it is pure'. chos kyi dbyings, 'the expanse of things' (Sanskrit dharmadhātu), is reality as the space in which all things are; its ye shes, 'wisdom', is the first of five, the wisdom of Vairocana.

sentences.i: a lustrous, splendid light, it comes piercing from the heart of Vairocana and his consort to the space before you, so bright that your eyes can hardly bear it.

sentences.l: That with together, the gods' light, white, lustreless, one, also, in-front piercing comes.
sentences.i: Together with it a dull white light, the light of the gods, also comes piercing before you.
sentences.n: The print has སྐྲག་མེད, 'fearless', a misprint for བཀྲག་མེད, 'lustreless, dull', corrected here: the print itself writes bkrag med for this same light just below, and so does the other recension. lha'i 'od, 'the light of the gods': each bright wisdom light comes with a dull light from one of the six realms of rebirth, here the realm of the gods. The print writes 'ong ngo at the line end as one syllable (འོངོ); it is written out. In the other recension this light dawns alongside the blue one instead of piercing toward him.

sentences.l: That's time-at, you, bad-karma by(?) power by, light blue, lustre with endowed, the dharma-expanse's wisdom, that, at, you, fear and terror having-arisen, fled, and:
sentences.i: At that time, driven by your bad karma, you will be afraid and terrified of that blue light, the lustrous wisdom of the expanse of reality, and flee from it,

sentences.l: The Thus-Gone-One's light-ray, the dharma-expanse's wisdom so-called it-is.
sentences.i: It is the light of the tathāgata, what is called the wisdom of the expanse of reality.
sentences.n: de bzhin gshegs pa, 'thus gone' (Sanskrit tathāgata), is a title of a buddha. 'od zer, 'light-ray', is here one word: the radiance of a buddha. The other recension begins this sentence with de ni, 'that'; the print has no subject, and 'it' is supplied. sentences.i: Think with devotion, 'This is the light of the compassion of the Blessed One Vairocana; I go to it for refuge', and pray.
sentences.n: bcom ldan 'das, 'Blessed One', in full. thugs rje, 'compassion', the respectful word. skyabs su mchi'o, 'I go for refuge': mchi is the humble verb 'to go', used of oneself before the holy. snyam pa'i, 'thinking', closes the words of the thought, as in 002. mos ba is the print's spelling of mos pa. gsol ba thob cig is uncertain: gsol ba, 'prayer, request', with thob, 'obtain', gives no clear sense; the translation takes it, as a guess, for 'make the prayer'. glossary.ཆེའོ: che'o — is great, are great (che 'big' + the sentence-ending -'o)
glossary.ཆོག་གོ: chog go — it suffices, it will do (chog 'enough' + the sentence-ending -go)
glossary.ཆོས་ཀྱི་དབྱིངས: chos kyi dbyings — expanse of reality, expanse of things (chos 'thing, reality' + kyi 'of' + dbyings 'expanse'; Sanskrit dharmadhātu)
glossary.ཆོས་ཉིད: chos nyid — reality itself, the true nature of things (chos 'thing' + nyid 'itself'; Sanskrit dharmatā)
glossary.ཇི་ལྟར: ji ltar — however, in what way (ji 'what' + ltar 'like')
glossary.ཉམས་ང་བ: nyams nga ba — fearsome, awesome (nyams nga ba, the print's spelling of nyam nga ba)
glossary.ཉི་མའི: nyi ma'i — of the sun (nyi ma 'sun' + -'i 'of')
glossary.ཉེ་དུས: nye dus — by relatives, the relatives (as the ones who act) (nye du 'relatives, kin' + -s 'by', marking who does the act)
glossary.ཉོན་ཅིག: nyon cig — listen! (nyon, imperative of nyan 'listen', + cig, which marks a command)
glossary.ཏིང་ངེ་འཛིན: ting nge 'dzin — meditative absorption, samādhi (ting nge 'dzin)
glossary.ཏེ: te — and, and so: links a verb to what follows (te, the form of ste after n, r, l; this print also writes it after other letters)
glossary.ཐིག་ལེ་བརྡལ་བའི: thig le brdal ba'i — of the Spreading Drop, the name of Vairocana's realm (thig le 'drop, sphere' + brdal 'spread out' + -ba'i 'of')
glossary.ཐུགས་ཀ: thugs ka — heart, chest (thugs ka), the respectful word
glossary.ཐུགས་པའི: thugs pa'i — uncertain; as printed, with thugs 'mind' (respectful), no sense; read, as a guess, as thug pa'i 'of reaching' (thug 'reach, meet' + -pa'i 'of')
glossary.ཐུགས་རྗེའི: thugs rje'i — of compassion (thugs rje 'compassion', respectful, + -'i 'of')
glossary.ཐེབས: thebs — to take hold, to strike home, to succeed (the result of 'debs)
glossary.ཐོ་ཡུག་ཏུ: tho yug tu — uncertain; as printed tho yug tu (tho yug + -tu 'to, in'): perhaps a spelling of mthong yul du 'in the field of sight', which the other recension has, or a word for 'all around'; 'about' is a guess
glossary.ཐོབ་ཅིག: thob cig — uncertain; perhaps 'obtain!' (thob 'obtain, get' + cig, which marks a command); gsol ba thob cig gives no clear sense, and is read, as a guess, 'make the prayer'
glossary.ཐོས: thos — heard, hears (thos 'to hear', the verb of hearing, beside nyan 'to listen')
glossary.ཐོས་བས: thos bas — because (he) heard (thos 'to hear' + -bas, the print's spelling of -pas 'because')
glossary.ད་ལྟ: da lta — now, at present (da lta)
glossary.ད་ལྟའི: da lta'i — of the present, of now (da lta 'now' + -'i 'of')
glossary.དཀོན་མཆོག་གསུམ: dkon mchog gsum — the Three Jewels: the Buddha, the teaching and the community (dkon 'rare' + mchog 'supreme' + gsum 'three')
glossary.དག་པའི: dag pa'i — of the pure (dag pa 'pure' + -'i 'of')
glossary.དགའ་བའི: dga' ba'i — of delight, of gladness (dga' 'glad' + -ba'i 'of')
glossary.དགོས: dgos — must, need to, have to (dgos)
glossary.དང: dang — and; with · after a verb: 'as soon as' (brgyal bsangs pa dang 'as soon as the faint has cleared')
glossary.དངངས: dngangs — dread, to be terrified (dngangs, the print's spelling of sngangs 'be terrified')
glossary.དངངས་ཤིག: dngangs shig — be terrified! (dngangs + shig, which marks a command); ma dngangs shig 'do not be terrified'
glossary.དངངས་སོ: dngangs so — is terrified (dngangs 'be terrified' + the sentence-ending -so)
glossary.དཔེར་ན: dper na — for example, as (dpe 'example' + -r 'as' + na 'if')
glossary.དབུས་ཕྱོགས: dbus phyogs — the centre, the central quarter (dbus 'centre' + phyogs 'direction, side')
glossary.དི་རི་རི: di ri ri — a rumbling sound (di ri ri, a doubled-sound word)
glossary.དུ་སྐད: du skad — as printed; no sense; almost certainly ngu skad 'sound of weeping' (ngu 'weep' + skad 'sound, voice'), which the other recension has; kept as printed
glossary.དུང་དུང: dung dung — longingly, ardently (dung dung, a doubled word akin to gdung 'to long for')
glossary.དུས་ཚོད: dus tshod — time, moment, occasion (dus 'time' + tshod 'measure')
glossary.དུས་སུ: dus su — at the time (dus + su 'at')
glossary.དེ: de — that; he, it. After a verb (also te, ste): 'and then'
glossary.དེ་ནས: de nas — then, after that (de 'that' + nas 'from')
glossary.དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པའི: de bzhin gshegs pa'i — of the tathāgata, of the one thus gone (de bzhin 'thus' + gshegs pa 'gone', respectful, + -'i 'of'); a title of a buddha
glossary.དེ་ཙ་ན: de tsa na — at that time, then (de 'that' + tsa na; a set phrase)
glossary.དེ་ལྟར: de ltar — thus, in that way (de 'that' + ltar 'like')
glossary.དེ་སྐད: de skad — thus, in those words (de 'that' + skad 'speech, words')
glossary.དོན: don — meaning, point, matter; a heading or part of a text
glossary.དོན་ཆེན: don chen — the great matter (don 'matter, aim' + chen 'great')
glossary.དྲག་པོས: drag pos — by the fierce, by the strong (drag po 'fierce' + -s 'by')
glossary.དྲུག་གོ: drug go — are six (drug 'six' + the sentence-ending -go)
glossary.ན: na — if, when (after the verb); also 'in, at'
glossary.ནང: nang — inside, within (nang): 'od kyi nang nas 'from within the light'
glossary.ནམ་མཁའི་དབྱིངས་ཕྱུག་མ: nam mkha'i dbyings phyug ma — Lady of the Expanse of Space, the consort of Vairocana (nam mkha' 'space' + -'i 'of' + dbyings 'expanse' + phyug ma 'rich one, mistress')
glossary.ནས: nas — from; after a verb: 'having done, and then'
glossary.ནི: ni — as for: marks the topic of the sentence
glossary.ནུས་པ: nus pa — power, ability, capacity (nus 'be able' + -pa)
glossary.ཕན་ཆད: phan chad — up to, until, as far as (phan chad)
glossary.ཕུང་པོ: phung po — mass, heap (phung po) · aggregate, one of the five that make up a person (phung po; Sanskrit skandha)
glossary.ཕྱག: phyag — hand (phyag), the respectful word; also 'homage'
glossary.ཕྱད: phyad — uncertain; no known verb phyad fits; perhaps a spelling of a verb of parting or turning away
glossary.བག་ཆགས: bag chags — habitual tendencies, the traces past actions leave in the mind (bag chags; Sanskrit vāsanā)
glossary.བཅད: bcad — cut off, stopped (bcad, past of gcod 'cut')
glossary.བཅོམ་པ: bcom pa — destroyed, having destroyed (bcom, past of 'joms 'destroy', + -pa); bcom pa bzhin du 'just as it destroys'
glossary.བཅོམ་ལྡན: bcom ldan — Blessed One, a title of a buddha (bcom ldan, short for bcom ldan 'das)
glossary.བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས: bcom ldan 'das — the Blessed One, a title of a buddha (bcom ldan 'das, Sanskrit bhagavān; 'das 'gone beyond')
glossary.བཏུབ་བོ: btub bo — can, is able, is fit (btub + the sentence-ending -bo): bsgyur du btub 'can be turned'
glossary.བཙམ་དུ: btsam du — uncertain; as printed gives no sense; probably tsam du 'to the extent of' (as in the other recension's ldir ba tsam du 'as loud as the roaring of'); a guess
glossary.བཞིན: bzhin — in the manner of, like, according to (bzhin 'like'); also 'to be like'
glossary.བཞིན་དུ: bzhin du — just as, like (bzhin 'like' + -du); after a verb 'while, as': sngar bzhin du 'as before'
glossary.བཞིའི: bzhi'i — of four (bzhi 'four' + -'i 'of'); zhag phyed dang bzhi 'three and a half days'
glossary.བཞུགས་པ: bzhugs pa — abiding, being present (bzhugs, respectful 'stay' + -pa)
glossary.བཟོད་པ: bzod pa — bearing, endurance (bzod 'bear, endure' + -pa): mi bzod pa 'unbearable'
glossary.བར་དུ: bar du — until, up to (bar 'interval' + -du 'to'); after ma + verb + gyi: 'until it comes'
glossary.བར་དོ: bar do — the between: the interval between two states, above all between death and rebirth (bar 'between' + do 'two')
glossary.བར་དོའི: bar do'i — of the bardo (bar do + -'i 'of')
glossary.བར་དོར: bar dor — in the bardo (bar do + -r 'in, into') · as the bardo: the -r marks what a thing is recognised as (bar dor ngo shes 'recognise as the bardo')
glossary.བརྗེད་ཅིག: brjed cig — forget! (brjed 'forget' + cig, which marks a command); ma brjed cig 'do not forget'
glossary.བརྗེད་པར: brjed par — forgetting, to forget (brjed 'forget' + -par 'to'); ma brjed par 'without forgetting'
glossary.བརྗོད: brjod — to say, to utter, to declare
glossary.བཤད་དོ: bshad do — says, said (bshad, past and future of 'chad 'to explain, to say', + the sentence-ending -do)
glossary.བཤུས: bshus — stripped, taken off (bshus), of clothes
glossary.བསངས་པ: bsangs pa — cleared, having cleared (bsangs 'cleared' + -pa): brgyal bsangs pa 'the faint having cleared'
glossary.བསམ་གཏན: bsam gtan — meditation, concentration, dhyāna (bsam gtan)
glossary.བསྒོམ་སྒྲུབ: bsgom sgrub — meditation and practice (bsgom, future of sgom 'to meditate', + sgrub 'to practise, to accomplish')
glossary.བསྒྱུར་དུ: bsgyur du — to turn, to change (bsgyur, past and future of sgyur 'to turn', + -du 'to')
glossary.བོས་བ: bos ba — calling, a call (bos, past of 'bod 'to call', + -ba, the print's spelling of -pa)
glossary.བྱ: bya — is to be done; called (bya, future of byed 'do'): zhes bya 'is called' · with 'I' as the doer: 'I shall do' (bya, future of byed), as in ngo shes bya 'I shall recognise'
glossary.བྱ་བ: bya ba — called; what is to be done (bya, future of byed 'do', + ba). zhes bya ba: 'so called'
glossary.བྱས: byas — did, made, having done (byas, past of byed 'do')
glossary.བྱུང: byung — came about, happened, occurred (byung, past of 'byung)
glossary.བྱུང་བ: byung ba — came about, happened (byung, past of 'byung, + -ba); dgos byung ba yin 'it has come about that (you) must'
glossary.བྱེད་ཅིག: byed cig — do (byed, the present stem of byed 'do', + cig, which marks a command): with ma, a prohibition, ma byed cig 'do not do!' (the imperative of byed is gyis)
glossary.བྲལ་བའི: bral ba'i — of parting, of being free of (bral 'part, be free of' + -ba'i 'of')
glossary.བྲོས: bros — fled, ran away (bros, past of 'bros 'flee')
glossary.མ: ma — not (before past and imperative verbs) · in a prohibition also before the present stem: ma byed cig 'do not do!'
glossary.མ་བུ: ma bu — mother and child (ma 'mother' + bu 'child'); in this teaching, the clear light of reality ('mother') and the clear light known in practice ('child')
glossary.མཆིའོ: mchi'o — I go (mchi, the humble 'go', + the sentence-ending -'o)
glossary.མཆོར་བ: mchor ba — splendid, beautiful (mchor ba); the other recension has 'tsher ba 'shimmering'
glossary.མཉམ་དུ: mnyam du — together, along with (mnyam 'equal, same' + -du)
glossary.མཐིང་ཁ: mthing kha — deep blue (mthing kha, the print's spelling of mthing ga)
glossary.མཐིང་ཁར: mthing khar — as deep blue (mthing kha, the print's spelling of mthing ga, + -r 'as')
glossary.མདུན་དུ: mdun du — in front (mdun 'the front' + du)
glossary.མདུན་པ: mdun pa — uncertain; mdun pa 'front' seems to stand for 'dun pa 'aspiration, intent', which the other recension has
glossary.མལ་ས: mal sa — bed, bed-place (mal 'bed' + sa 'place, ground')
glossary.མི: mi — not (before present and future verbs)
glossary.མི་ཡུལ་དུ: mi yul du — in the human world, in the land of humans (mi 'person' + yul 'land' + -du 'in')
glossary.མུན་བ: mun ba — darkness (mun pa, spelled mun ba in this print)
glossary.མེ་རེ་རེ: me re re — quivering, flickering shimmer (me re re, a doubled-sound word)
glossary.མེད་དོ: med do — there is not (med + the sentence-ending -do)
glossary.མེད་པས: med pas — because there is not (med 'there is not' + -pas 'because')
glossary.མོས་པ: mos pa — devotion, trust, interest (mos pa)
glossary.མོས་བ: mos ba — devotion (mos ba, the print's spelling of mos pa)
glossary.ཙམ་དུ: tsam du — just so far, just to the point of (tsam + du)
glossary.ཚིག་དོན: tshig don — the words and their meaning (tshig 'word' + don 'meaning')
glossary.ཚེ་འདས: tshe 'das — one whose life has passed, the dead person (tshe 'life' + 'das 'gone beyond')
glossary.ཞག: zhag — day, a day and night (zhag)
glossary.ཞལ་སྦྱར: zhal sbyar — in union, face joined to face (zhal 'face', respectful, + sbyar 'joined')
glossary.ཞི་ཁྲོའི: zhi khro'i — of the peaceful and wrathful ones (zhi khro + -'i 'of')
glossary.ཞེན་ཅིག: zhen cig — cling! (zhen 'cling' + cig, which marks a command); ma zhen cig 'do not cling'
glossary.ཞེས: zhes — so, thus: closes a quotation or a name (like inverted commas)
glossary.ཟས་སྐལ: zas skal — food-share, the portion of food set aside for a person (zas 'food' + skal 'share, lot')
glossary.ཟིན་པར: zin par — seizing, holding (zin + -par): zin par the tshom med 'no doubt that (they) will seize it'
glossary.ཟིན་པས: zin pas — because (it) was seized, held (zin, the intransitive verb beside 'dzin 'to hold', + -pas 'because'): ngos ma zin pas 'because you did not recognise'
glossary.ཟུག: zug — to pierce, to stab, to stick in (zug)
glossary.ཟེར: zer — say, call (zer 'say, speak') · ray, ray of light (zer), as in 'od zer, and sgra 'od zer gsum 'sound, light and rays'
glossary.འཁོར་བའི: 'khor ba'i — of saṃsāra, of the round ('khor ba 'the round, saṃsāra' + -'i 'of')
glossary.འཁོར་བར: 'khor bar — in saṃsāra, in the round ('khor ba 'the round, saṃsāra' + -r 'in')
glossary.འཁོར་རོ: 'khor ro — circles, goes round, wanders ('khor 'go round' + the sentence-ending -ro)
glossary.འཁོར་ལོ: 'khor lo — wheel ('khor lo); the wheel of the teaching
glossary.འཁྱམ་མོ: 'khyam mo — wanders ('khyam, a form of 'khyams 'wander', + the sentence-ending -mo)
glossary.འཁྲུལ་སྣང: 'khrul snang — deluded appearance, illusory vision ('khrul 'be deluded' + snang 'appear')
glossary.འགག: 'gag — narrow pass, crucial point, critical moment ('gag); set phrase 'gag la thug pa
glossary.འགྲུབ: 'grub — is accomplished, comes about ('grub 'be accomplished'): don 'grub 'the aim is achieved'
glossary.འགྲོ: 'gro — to go, goes ('gro, present; past song or phyin, imperative song)
glossary.འཆག་པ: 'chag pa — uncertain; walking, treading ('chag 'walk, tread' + -pa); the other recension has phyags 'sweep', so whether the bed is trodden or cleared is a guess
glossary.འཆར: 'char — to dawn, to arise, to appear
glossary.འཆར་དུ: 'char du — to dawn, to arise ('char 'dawn, arise' + -du 'to'): 'char du 'ong 'will dawn'
glossary.འཆི་ཁའི: 'chi kha'i — of the point of death ('chi kha 'the brink of death' + -'i 'of')
glossary.འཆི་རྒྱུ: 'chi rgyu — something to die, an occasion for dying ('chi 'die' + rgyu 'cause, occasion')
glossary.འཇིག་རྟེན: 'jig rten — the world ('jig 'perish' + rten 'support': the perishable support)
glossary.འཇིགས: 'jigs — to fear, to be afraid ('jigs); fear
glossary.འཇིགས་ཤིག: 'jigs shig — be afraid! ('jigs 'fear' + shig, which marks a command); ma 'jigs shig 'do not be afraid'
glossary.འཇིགས་སོ: 'jigs so — is afraid, fears ('jigs 'fear' + the sentence-ending -so)
glossary.འཇིགས་སྣང: 'jigs snang — fearful appearance, appearance of fear ('jigs 'fear' + snang 'appearance')
glossary.འདི་སྐད་དུ: 'di skad du — in these words, thus ('di 'this' + skad 'speech, words' + -du 'in')
glossary.འདིར: 'dir — here, in this ('di + -r 'in') · in 'dir btsam du, as printed, perhaps for ldir 'roaring' (ldir ba tsam du 'as loud as the roaring of'); a guess
glossary.འདུ་ཤེས: 'du shes — notion, perception, idea ('du shes; Sanskrit saṃjñā)
glossary.འདོན: 'don — to recite, to utter, to say aloud
glossary.འཕྲད: 'phrad — to meet, to come upon ('phrad): X dang 'phrad 'to meet with X'
glossary.འཕྲོད: 'phrod — to meet, to be received (ngo 'phrod: 'the face is met', to recognise)
glossary.འཕྲོད་པའི: 'phrod pa'i — of the meeting, of recognition ('phrod 'meet' + -pa'i 'of'): ngo 'phrod pa'i gnad 'the key to recognition'
glossary.འབྱུང: 'byung — to come about, to occur, to arise ('byung; byung is its past)
glossary.འབྱུང་བས: 'byung bas — because it happens, since it comes about ('byung 'occur' + -bas, the print's spelling of -pas 'because')
glossary.འོ་བརྒྱལ: 'o brgyal — worn out, weary, exhausted ('o brgyal); the other recension has brgyal 'faints'
glossary.འོང: 'ong — comes, happens, it may happen that ('ong 'come')
glossary.འོང་བས: 'ong bas — because it comes, since it will come ('ong 'come' + -bas, the print's spelling of -pas 'because')
glossary.འོངས་པས: 'ongs pas — having come, therefore ('ongs, past of 'ong 'come', + -pas 'because')
glossary.འོད་གསལ: 'od gsal — clear light, luminosity: the nature of mind, said to show itself bare at death ('od 'light' + gsal 'clear')
glossary.འོད་ཟེར: 'od zer — ray of light, radiance ('od 'light' + zer 'ray')
glossary.ཡང: yang — also, even, though (written kyang after g, d, b, s)
glossary.ཡབ་ཡུམ: yab yum — father and mother; a buddha and his consort in union (yab 'father' + yum 'mother')
glossary.ཡིན་ནོ: yin no — is, are (yin 'to be' + the sentence-ending -no)
glossary.ཡིན་པར: yin par — that it is, as being (yin pa 'being' + -r 'as, that'): X yin par shes 'know that it is X'
glossary.ཡུམ: yum — mother; a buddha's female partner, consort (yum)
glossary.ཡེ་ཤེས: ye shes — wisdom, primordial knowing (ye 'from the first' + shes 'know'; Sanskrit jñāna)
glossary.ཡེངས་པར: yengs par — distractedly, in distraction (yengs pa 'to be distracted' + -r): ma yengs par 'undistracted'
glossary.ཡོད་དོ: yod do — there is (yod 'there is' + the sentence-ending -do)
glossary.ཡོད་པས: yod pas — because there is (yod 'there is' + -pas 'because')
glossary.རང་བཞིན: rang bzhin — own nature, intrinsic nature (rang 'self' + bzhin 'manner')
glossary.རང་མདངས: rang mdangs — own radiance, natural glow (rang 'self' + mdangs 'radiance, glow')
glossary.རང་ཤར: rang shar — arisen of itself, self-arisen (rang 'self' + shar, past of 'char 'arise')
glossary.རང་སྒྲ: rang sgra — own sound, natural sound (rang 'self' + sgra 'sound')
glossary.རང་སྣང: rang snang — self-appearance, one's own appearance (rang 'self' + snang 'appear'): what the mind itself shows
glossary.རང་སྣང་དུ: rang snang du — as one's own appearance (rang snang 'self-appearance' + -du 'as')
glossary.རིག་པར: rig par — as awareness (rig pa 'knowing, awareness' + -r 'as')
glossary.རིགས་ཀྱི་བུ: rigs kyi bu — child of the family, child of noble family (rigs 'family' + kyi 'of' + bu 'son, child'; Sanskrit kulaputra)
glossary.རུ་ལོག: ru log — uncertain; perhaps 'the camp turns back' (ru 'camp, division of troops' + log 'turn back'), read as 'the course of saṃsāra is reversed'; a guess
glossary.རྡོས་བྱས: rdos byas — made of coarse matter, solid (rdos byas, the print's spelling of gdos bcas 'material')
glossary.རྣམ་པ: rnam pa — kind, sort, way (rnam pa)
glossary.རྣམ་པར་ཤེས་པའི: rnam par shes pa'i — of consciousness (rnam par shes pa 'consciousness' + -'i 'of'): the fifth of the five aggregates
glossary.རྣམ་པར་སྣང་མཛད: rnam par snang mdzad — Vairocana, 'He Who Makes Appear in Every Way' (rnam par 'in every way' + snang 'appear' + mdzad, respectful 'do, make'); the buddha of the centre
glossary.རྣམས: rnams — plural marker, set after the noun and its adjectives
glossary.ལ: la — to, at, in, for; after a verb or adjective: 'and'
glossary.ལ་སོགས: la sogs — and so on, etcetera (la sogs: la 'to' + sogs 'et cetera')
glossary.ལམ་གྱིས: lam gyis — vividly, in a flash
glossary.ལམ་པ: lam pa — a flash, a gleam (lam, as in lam gyis 'in a flash', + -pa): gsal lam pa 'a flash of clarity'; the other recension has gsal lam me ba 'clear and flickering'
glossary.ལས: las — from, out of · karma, action (las): las kyi 'of karma'; after a verb or noun, 'other than, of, from among'
glossary.ལས་ངན: las ngan — bad karma (las 'action, karma' + ngan 'bad')
glossary.ལུགས་འབྱུང: lugs 'byung — arising in order, in sequence (lugs 'manner, order' + 'byung 'arise'); uncertain, a guess at the sense; both recensions have it
glossary.ལུས་སུ: lus su — as a body, in a body (lus 'body' + -su 'as, in')
glossary.ལྡན་པ: ldan pa — having, endowed with (ldan 'have, possess' + -pa)
glossary.ལྷང་ལྷང: lhang lhang — clearly, distinctly (lhang lhang, a doubled word)
glossary.ཤ་ཁྲག: sha khrag — flesh and blood (sha 'flesh' + khrag 'blood')
glossary.ཤར་དུ: shar du — to arise, to dawn (shar, past of 'char 'arise', + -du 'to'): shar du 'ong 'will arise'
glossary.ཤར་བས: shar bas — because it has arisen, as (it has) arisen (shar, past of 'char 'arise', + -bas, the print's spelling of -pas 'because'); ma shar bas 'because it has not yet arisen'
glossary.ཤིང: shing — and, while (links two verbs; also cing, zhing)
glossary.ཤེས: shes — to know, to recognise (shes); ngo shes 'recognise, know the face'
glossary.ཤེས་པ: shes pa — knowing; awareness, consciousness (shes 'know' + pa)
glossary.ཤེས་པའི: shes pa'i — of knowing, that knows (shes 'to know' + -pa'i 'of'): ngo mi shes pa'i 'in which one does not recognise'
glossary.སེངྒེའི: sengge'i — of the lion (seng ge 'lion' + -'i 'of'; printed with the n and g stacked)
glossary.སོང་ཞིག: song zhig — go! (song, imperative of 'gro 'go', + zhig, which marks a command)
glossary.སོས་ཁའི: sos kha'i — of spring (sos kha, the print's spelling of sos ka, + -'i 'of')
glossary.སྐུ་མདོག: sku mdog — body colour, colour of a buddha or deity (sku 'body' + mdog 'colour'), the respectful word
glossary.སྐུ་རུ: sku ru — as bodies, as divine forms (sku 'body', the respectful word, + -ru 'as')
glossary.སྐྱབས་སུ: skyabs su — for refuge, as refuge (skyabs 'refuge' + -su 'to'): skyabs su mchi'o 'I go for refuge'
glossary.སྐྱེས: skyes — arisen, born (skyes, past of skye 'be born, arise')
glossary.སྐྱེས་གནས: skyes gnas — place of birth (skyes 'born' + gnas 'place'); the print's spelling of skye gnas
glossary.སྐྲག: skrag — to be frightened, to be terrified (skrag); fright
glossary.སྐྲག་གོ: skrag go — is frightened (skrag 'be frightened' + the sentence-ending -go)
glossary.སྐྲག་ཅིག: skrag cig — be frightened! (skrag + cig, which marks a command); ma skrag cig 'do not be frightened'
glossary.སྐྲག་པ: skrag pa — fright, being frightened (skrag 'be frightened' + -pa)
glossary.སྐྲག་པར: skrag par — being frightened, to be frightened (skrag pa 'fright' + -r); ma skrag par 'without fear'
glossary.སྒྱུ་ལུས: sgyu lus — illusory body: the body one seems to have after death, made of mind and not of flesh (sgyu 'illusion, trick' + lus 'body')
glossary.སྙམ་བའི: snyam ba'i — of thinking (snyam 'think' + -ba'i, the print's spelling of -pa'i 'of')
glossary.སྙིང: snying — heart (snying); snying mi dga' 'the heart not glad', sad
glossary.སྟེ: ste — and, namely: a linking word after a verb or a statement, leading on to what follows (also te, de)
glossary.སྟོང: stong — empty · thousand (stong), as in 'brug stong 'a thousand thunderclaps'
glossary.སྣང་པ: snang pa — appearance (snang pa, the print's spelling of snang ba)
glossary.སྣང་བ: snang ba — appearance, what appears to the senses or the mind; light
glossary.སྣང་ཚུལ: snang tshul — way of appearing, how things appear (snang 'appear' + tshul 'manner')
glossary.སྤངས: spangs — abandoned, given up (spangs, past of spong 'give up'): spangs byas 'having given up'
glossary.སྲིད་པ: srid pa — becoming, existence: the round of birth and death
glossary.སྲིད་པའི: srid pa'i — of becoming, of existence (srid pa + -'i 'of')

about: This part finishes the second bardo and opens the third. Whoever misses the first clear light at death meets a second, in a body made of mind, at a moment when he cannot tell whether he has died; if he recognises it then, he is freed before the visions of karma begin. If not, the bardo of reality dawns. The dead man sees his relatives weeping, his share of food cut off and his clothes taken away; he sees them and hears them call, but they cannot see or hear him, and he goes away unhappy. Sounds, lights and rays appear and terrify him. Now the reader gives the Great Pointing-Out: he names the six bardos, tells the dead man that he has died and that clinging to this life is useless, and gives him six lines of verse to say to himself. The sounds, lights and rays are the radiance of his own reality, and a body made of mind cannot be harmed or die. After three and a half days unconscious he wakes into the bardo, and the first day begins: the sky turns blue, and from the central realm the white buddha Vairocana appears in union with his consort. The blinding blue light of the wisdom of the expanse of reality pierces toward the dead man, and with it the dull white light of the gods. He will fear the bright light and be drawn to the dull one; he is told to trust the bright light and pray to it.
